pageState.description: Read the current Instagram route, authentication gate, challenge, rate-limit, and hydration state.

searchState.description: Verify that Instagram reached an active keyword search surface and distinguish results, an explicit empty state, and login or challenge gates.

returns.description: Search route, query, gate, and result state.

setSearchQuery.description: Set a query in the visible Instagram search input and dispatch input events; this never follows, likes, comments, or sends messages.

returns.description: Whether the visible search input accepted the query.

searchResults.description: Extract visible Instagram profile, hashtag, location, post, or reel search candidates without interacting with them.

viewport_only.description: Only include results intersecting the viewport.

scrollResults.description: Scroll an Instagram search surface by one bounded viewport step to hydrate more candidates.

nudge_up.description: Scroll slightly upward instead of down.

to_top.description: Reset the search surface to the top.

profileDetail.description: Extract the active Instagram profile, biography, visible counts, external URL, and canonical identity.

returns.description: Visible Instagram profile details or an explicit gate state.

profilePosts.description: Extract visible post and reel cards from the active Instagram profile.

limit.description: Maximum post or reel cards to return.

viewport_only.description: Only include cards intersecting the viewport.

returns.description: Visible Instagram profile posts and reels.

postDetail.description: Extract the active Instagram post or reel, caption, author, media, publication time, and visible engagement metadata.

returns.description: Visible Instagram post details or an explicit gate state.

comments.description: Extract comments currently visible on the active Instagram post or reel; never likes, replies, or submits anything.
